gold_review.explanation: parse_completion reads content only when completion[-1] is a dict; under verifiers 0.3.1 messages are pydantic objects so content is '' and every reward (exact/closeness/format) is 0 even for a valid <solution> (version rot; pyproject only pins verifiers>=0.1.9). Note the env also needs <solution>{answer}</solution> (XMLParser fields reasoning/solution), which our variants lacked.
gold_review.evidence: countdown.py:356 `completion[-1].get('content','') if isinstance(completion[-1], dict) else ''`; :476 XMLParser(fields=['reasoning','solution']); pyproject verifiers>=0.1.9 resolved to 0.3.1; gold_raw.log exact_match/closeness/format r1=[0.0]*5
